# Prep data

```{r}
#Alternate Cues
alt_cue <- import("data/AlternateCues.csv")

exclude_subjects <- alt_cue %>%
  filter(block != 0) %>%
  group_by(id) %>% 
  summarize(acc = mean(1-error),
            N = n())

exclude_subjects <- exclude_subjects %>%
  filter(acc < 0.8)

exclude_subjects <- c(exclude_subjects$id, 201, 901, 902, 959, 975)

alt_cue <- alt_cue %>%
  group_by(id, block, trial) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  filter(!id %in% exclude_subjects) %>%
  group_by(id, block) %>%
  mutate(trialgroup = ifelse(cycle == 1, 1, 0),
         trialgroup = cumsum(trialgroup),
         is_bivalent = ifelse(dim1 == 4 | dim2 == 4, 0, 1),
         prev_bivalent = lag(is_bivalent, 1),
         was_prev_error = lag(error, 1),
         prev_task = lag(task, 1),
         switch = ifelse(prev_task == task, 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(id, block, trialgroup) %>%
  mutate(prev_bivalent = prev_bivalent[1]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(id = factor(id),
         prev_bivalent = factor(prev_bivalent),
         is_bivalent = factor(is_bivalent),
         cycle = factor(cycle),
         switch = factor(switch),
         prev_bivalent_contr = case_when(prev_bivalent == 1 ~ 0.5,
                                              prev_bivalent == 0 ~ -0.5),
         is_bivalent_contr = case_when(is_bivalent == 1 ~ 0.5,
                                        is_bivalent == 0 ~ -0.5),
         switch_contr = case_when(switch == 1 ~ 1,
                                  switch == 0 ~ 0)) %>%
  filter(block != 0) %>%
  filter(trialgroup != 1) %>%
  group_by(id, prev_bivalent, is_bivalent, cycle) %>%
  mutate(time_M = mean(time[error == 0 & was_prev_error == 0]),
         time_SD = sd(time[error == 0 & was_prev_error == 0]),
         time_z = (time - time_M)/time_SD,
         time_outlier = ifelse(abs(time_z) >= 3, 1, 0),
         filter_correct = ifelse(error == 1 | was_prev_error == 1, 1, 0),
         time_log = log(time)) %>%
  filter(time_outlier == 0) 

nrow(alt_cue)
```

# Data Aggregation by cycle

```{r}
alt_cue_agg_ID <- alt_cue %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent, prev_bivalent, switch, cycle) %>%
  summarize(RT = mean(time[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_log = mean(time_log[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            Error = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE))

alt_cue_agg <- alt_cue_agg_ID %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "RT") %>%
  mutate(RT = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "RT_log") %>%
  mutate(RT_log = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "Error") %>%
  mutate(Error = DV_n) %>%
  group_by(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent, switch, cycle) %>%
  summarize(RT_m = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_ci_lower = get_ci(RT, RT_m)[1],
            RT_ci_upper = get_ci(RT, RT_m)[2],
            RT_log_m = mean(RT_log, na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_log_ci_lower = get_ci(RT_log, RT_log_m)[1],
            RT_log_ci_upper = get_ci(RT_log, RT_log_m)[2],
            Error_m = mean(Error, na.rm = TRUE),
            Error_ci_lower = get_ci(Error, Error_m)[1],
            Error_ci_upper = get_ci(Error, Error_m)[2]
  )
```


# Plots of correct RTs and Errors

```{r}
pos <- position_dodge(width = 0.1)

ggplot(alt_cue_agg, aes(x = cycle, y = RT_log_m, color = is_bivalent, linetype = prev_bivalent, group = interaction(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = RT_log_ci_lower, ymax = RT_log_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()


ggplot(alt_cue_agg, aes(x = cycle, y = RT_m, color = is_bivalent, linetype = prev_bivalent, group = interaction(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = RT_ci_lower, ymax = RT_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()



ggplot(alt_cue_agg, aes(x = cycle, y = Error_m, color = is_bivalent, linetype = prev_bivalent, group = interaction(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Error_ci_lower, ymax = Error_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()
```

# Stats: 
## RT


```{r}
alt_cue_rt_log <- lmer(time_log ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (is_bivalent_contr + prev_bivalent_contr + switch_contr||id), 
     alt_cue %>% 
       filter(filter_correct == 0))

make_model_table(alt_cue_rt_log)

alt_cue_rt <- lmer(time ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (is_bivalent_contr + prev_bivalent_contr + switch_contr||id), 
     alt_cue %>% 
       filter(filter_correct == 0))

#summary(alt_cue_rt)

make_model_table(alt_cue_rt)



```


## Errors

```{r}
alt_cue_error <- glmer(error ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (is_bivalent_contr + prev_bivalent_contr + switch_contr|id),
                      family = "binomial",
                      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                   alt_cue)

saveRDS(alt_cue_error, "dominik/models/alt_cue_errors.RDS")
alt_cue_error <- readRDS("dominik/models/alt_cue_errors.RDS")
make_model_table(alt_cue_error)


```

# DDM analysis

## Aggregation and data processing


```{r}
alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm <- alt_cue %>%
  mutate(RT_s = time/1000) %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent, prev_bivalent, switch, cycle) %>%
  summarize(RT_s_m = mean(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_s_var = var(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            Error = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
            N_trials = n()) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ezddm = list(ezddm(propCorrect = convert_extremes(1-Error), 
                            rtCorrectVariance_seconds = RT_s_var, 
                            rtCorrectMean_seconds = RT_s_m, 
                            nTrials = N_trials))) %>%
  unnest(ezddm)



alt_cue_agg_ddm <- alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent, prev_bivalent, switch, cycle) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "a") %>%
  mutate(a = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "v") %>%
  mutate(v = DV_n) %>%
  normWS(s = "id", dv = "Ter") %>%
  mutate(Ter = DV_n) %>%
  group_by(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent, switch, cycle) %>%
  summarize(a_m = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE),
            a_ci_lower = get_ci(a, a_m)[1],
            a_ci_upper = get_ci(a, a_m)[2],
            v_m = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
            v_ci_lower = get_ci(v, v_m)[1],
            v_ci_upper = get_ci(v, v_m)[2],
            Ter_m = mean(Ter, na.rm = TRUE),
            Ter_ci_lower = get_ci(Ter, Ter_m)[1],
            Ter_ci_upper = get_ci(Ter, Ter_m)[2],)
```

## Plots

```{r}
plt_ddm_a <- ggplot(alt_cue_agg_ddm, aes(x = cycle, y = a_m, color = is_bivalent, linetype = prev_bivalent, group = interaction(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = a_ci_lower, ymax = a_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()

plt_ddm_v <- ggplot(alt_cue_agg_ddm, aes(x = cycle, y = v_m, color = is_bivalent, linetype = prev_bivalent, group = interaction(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = v_ci_lower, ymax = v_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()


plt_ddm_Ter <- ggplot(alt_cue_agg_ddm, aes(x = cycle, y = Ter_m, color = is_bivalent, linetype = prev_bivalent, group = interaction(is_bivalent, prev_bivalent)))+
  geom_line(position = pos)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Ter_ci_lower, ymax = Ter_ci_upper), width = 0.1, position = pos)+
  theme_classic()

ggpubr::ggarrange(plt_ddm_a, plt_ddm_v, plt_ddm_Ter, common.legend = TRUE, nrow = 1)  
  

```

## Statistical Models

### First prep data so that it's ignoring cycle

```{r}
alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm_nocycle <- alt_cue %>%
  mutate(RT_s = time/1000) %>%
  group_by(id, is_bivalent, is_bivalent_contr, prev_bivalent, prev_bivalent_contr, switch, switch_contr) %>%
  summarize(RT_s_m = mean(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            RT_s_var = var(RT_s[filter_correct == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
            Error = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
            N_trials = n()) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ezddm = list(ezddm(propCorrect = convert_extremes(1-Error), 
                            rtCorrectVariance_seconds = RT_s_var, 
                            rtCorrectMean_seconds = RT_s_m, 
                            nTrials = N_trials))) %>%
  unnest(ezddm)
```

### Models

```{r}
alt_cue_a <- lmer(a ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (is_bivalent_contr + prev_bivalent_contr + switch_contr|id), 
     alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm_nocycle)

#summary(alt_cue_a)
make_model_table(alt_cue_a)

alt_cue_v <- lmer(v ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (is_bivalent_contr + prev_bivalent_contr + switch_contr|id), 
     alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm_nocycle)
#summary(alt_cue_v)
make_model_table(alt_cue_v)


alt_cue_Ter <- lmer(Ter ~ is_bivalent_contr * prev_bivalent_contr * switch_contr + (is_bivalent_contr + prev_bivalent_contr + switch_contr|id), 
     alt_cue_agg_ID_ddm_nocycle)
#summary(alt_cue_Ter)
make_model_table(alt_cue_Ter)
```
